body_html:
The Global Rebound armchair brings a patented flex-back to everyday guest seating, gently following each visitor's movement while a tough polypropylene shell stands up to constant use. It stacks five high on the floor (ten on a dolly) so a waiting room or training space clears in minutes, and a versatile family of arm and armless models keeps your layout consistent across rooms. Designed and built in Canada, it pairs clean contemporary lines with the resilience institutional spaces demand.

Features

  • Patented flex-back design that follows the sitter's movement for relaxed, supportive seating
  • Durable, easy-to-clean polypropylene seat and back ideal for high-traffic waiting room chairs
  • Stacks five high on the floor and ten high on a transport dolly for fast room turnover
  • Choice of 14 polypropylene shell colours with coordinating frame finishes; ships standard with a black frame
  • Optional upholstered seat cushion in fabric, vinyl or leather
  • Fully recyclable polypropylene shell and tubular steel frame
  • Rated to a 400 lb active weight load on models with glides

Specifications

Overall dimensions measure 26.25" W x 20.5" D x 32.75" H. The shell and frame are GREENGUARD Gold certified and meet ANSI/BIFMA standards. Backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame and components, with 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh.
